response.text:
I can do that, but I need a few quick confirmations so I don't remove the wrong messages.

Please tell me:

1) How should I identify “Uber” emails? (pick one or tell me another)
   - from:@uber.com — any message from an uber.com address (receipts, promos, support)
   - from:uber — any sender with “uber” in the name or address
   - subject:uber — messages with “uber” in the subject
2) What action do you want for the matched messages?
   - Archive (remove from Inbox, keep in All Mail)
   - Move to Trash (recoverable for ~30 days)
   - Permanently delete (irreversible)
3) Scope:
   - Inbox only
   - All mail (Inbox, Sent, archived, etc.)
4) Do you want me also to create a filter to automatically remove future Uber messages? (yes/no)
5) Want a preview (I’ll show up to 10 example messages) before I perform the action? (recommended)

Reply with your choices (for example: “from:@uber.com, move to Trash, all mail, create filter, show preview”) and I’ll proceed.
